verses.1: Do not upset your hearts. Believe in the God, and also believe in me.
verses.2: In my father’s house, there are many people who can be considered as “only ones”. But if not, then I would say to you that I am going to prepare a place for you.
verses.3: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back again and leave you with Him, so that both I and you can be together wherever we are.
verses.4: And wherever I lead you, you will know the way.
verses.5: Thomas says to him, “Lord, we do not know how you will act. How can we possibly know the way?”
verses.6: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one can come to the Father except through me.”
verses.7: If you know me, and if you also know my father, then please get to know him too. Please learn about him and get to know him well.
verses.8: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us your father, and give us what we need.”
verses.9: Jesus said to him, “In a year, I will be with you again. But then you won’t recognize me, Philip. The angel has shown me the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?”
verses.10: Don’t you believe that I am in my father, and that my father is also in me? The words I say to you aren’t mine own words; it’s my father who does those things while being in me.
verses.11: You believe that I am in my father, and that the father is in me. But if not, then you must believe it based on their actions.
verses.12: Indeed, I say to you, he who believes in me will do the works that I do. He will even do greater things than these, for I will go before him to the Father.
verses.13: And whatever you may ask for in my name, I will do it, so that the Father may be glorified through His Son.
verses.14: If you have any questions about my name, I will answer them.
verses.15: If you love me, then obey my commands.
verses.16: I also ask the father and the other guest to give you this gift, so that I can live among you until the end of time.
verses.17: The spirit of truth, which the world cannot attain to; it is something that neither can be seen nor understood by anyone. But you shall know it, for it remains with you and will always be with you.
verses.18: I will not leave you in vain; I am coming to you.
verses.19: It’s still small, and the world no longer considers me important. But you, you will consider me important, because I live, and so do you.
verses.20: On that day, you will know that I am in my homeland, and you are also with me. I am among you.
verses.21: He who obeys my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. And he who loves me will be loved by my father. I also love him, and I will show myself to him.
verses.22: Jouda says to him, not Iskariotes. Lord, why must you appear before us and also before the world?
verses.23: Jesus replied to him, “If anyone loves me, he will keep my word. Then my Father will love that person too. And I will be with him, and we will do nothing together.”
verses.24: He doesn’t follow my words; and the words you hear aren’t mine, but rather those of the person who sent me here as a father.
verses.25: These words I spoke to you, while standing among you.
verses.26: And that Holy Spirit, whom the Father sent through my name, will teach you everything and remind you of everything I have said to you.
verses.27: I have come to bring you peace. I will give you peace. Not as the world gives me things. Do not let your hearts be troubled or upset.
verses.28: You heard me say that. I’m coming to you right away. If you forgive me for going to my father, then I will do so. After all, my father is more important to me.
verses.29: And now I say this to you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will be able to believe it.
verses.30: I will no longer talk much to you. For the ruler of the world is coming; and I have nothing to offer him.
verses.31: But so that the world will know that I love my father. And just as my father taught me, so do I act. Come, let’s go together.
